in_hebrew.name: אלברט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Old English name Ælfberht, which is composed of the Old English elements ælf (elf) and beorht (bright, famous)

in_greek.name: Αιλβερτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Greek transliteration of the Old English name Ælfberht. Aethernos means 'god of the sky' and Helikrónes means 'shining, bright, or famous warrior'

in_latin.name: Albertus
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin form of the Old English name Ælfberht. Al- (El) and berht (bright, famous)
